judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Blazor CRUD components
judgeRationales.rationale: Both appear to fulfill the requested Employee EF/SQLite CRUD scaffold with migrations. B has a modest quality edge by supplying management UI for the required Department relationship and reporting a final zero-warning build; the extra work is relevant rather than distracting.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold MVC CRUD with an existing DbContext
judgeRationales.rationale: Both appear to fulfill the core task, but B provides substantially stronger functional validation of the actual CRUD operations and proactively fixes the likely required-navigation model-validation failure. Its author deletion behavior also handles the required FK more gracefully.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Minimal API child and required parent CRUD
judgeRationales.rationale: Both appear to complete the requested implementation and verify it. A provides stronger evidence of comprehensive endpoint OpenAPI naming and, importantly, migration application as part of application startup rather than relying solely on a manually applied development database migration.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Minimal API endpoints with OpenAPI
judgeRationales.rationale: B satisfies every listed requirement, including migrations, a CRUD .http client file, and rich OpenAPI metadata. A implements the core API and SQLite context but misses key explicit requirements by using EnsureCreated instead of migrations and omitting the .http file and documented rich metadata.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Scaffold Razor Pages CRUD with EF Core and SQLite
